title: Assault 2 not applied to Garen's own Might for lethal-damage/survival when attacking
expected: Root cause at HEAD (f63bf1b): packages/riftbound-engine/src/combat/combat-resolver.ts `lethalThreshold()` (HEAD lines ~87-95) added only `Shield` for role==="defender" and nothing for attackers, while `calculateUnitMight()` (line ~109) does add Assault to damage dealt — so an attacking Garen deals 7 but is kill-checked (checkKills → lethalThreshold(unit,"attacker"), line 250/257) against printed 5, dying to 6 damage. distributeDamage(attackers, ..., "attacker") (line 237→178) had the same gap. The repo test src/__tests__/cards/ogs-007-024.test.ts:54 was `test.failing("BUG: Assault 2 also raises his lethal threshold...")` at HEAD. NOTE: the working tree already carries an UNCOMMITTED fix (git diff shows `else if (role === "attacker") might += getKeywordValue(unit, "Assault")` added at combat-resolver.ts:97-98 and the test flipped to plain `test`); with that diff `bun test ogs-007-024.test.ts` is 6 pass / 0 fail. Bug is real in committed code; fix is in-flight but not committed.
observed: Garen (fresh, undamaged) attacked alone into two enemy 3-Might Mech tokens at Aspirant's Climb. He dealt 7 damage (Mechs took 4 and 3, both died — so Assault WAS added to damage dealt) but Garen himself went to trash with damage counter 6; battlefield left empty/uncontrolled, no point scored. The mirror case as defender (Shield 2) correctly survived 6 damage, so only the attacker-side threshold is wrong. Matches the repo's own test.failing in __tests__/cards/ogs-007-024.test.ts.
